python -c "
import sys; sys.path.insert(0, '.')
from phase2_predictor import build_model, load_dataset, split_features_targets, train_predict
import pandas as pd
print('MultiOutputRegressor import verified:', 'MultiOutputRegressor' in str(build_model('random_forest')))
df = load_dataset('materials_thermal_dataset.csv')
X, y = split_features_targets(df)
res = train_predict(X, y, multi_target=True)
print('Multi-output train ratio:', res['metrics']['n_train'] / (res['metrics']['n_train'] + res['metrics']['n_test']))
print('Metrics:', res['metrics'])
"
